verses.sanskrit: भीष्म उवाच। एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु वसिष्ठमृषिसत्तमम् । इक्ष्वाकुवंशजो राजा सौदासो वदतां वरः ॥१॥
verses.english: Bhishma said Formerly, king Saudasa born of Ikshvaku's race, that foremost of eloquent men, on one occasion approached his family priest, viz., Vashishtha, that foremost of Rishis, crowned with ascetic success, capable of passing through every region, the receptacle of Brahma, and gifted with eternal life, and put to him the following question.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलोकचरं सिद्धं ब्रह्मकोशं सनातनम् । पुरोहितमभिप्रष्टुमभिवाद्योपचक्रमे ॥२॥
सौदास उवाच । त्रैलोक्ये भगवन्किंस्वित्पवित्रं कथ्यतेऽनघ । यत्कीर्तयन्सदा मर्त्यः प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यमुत्तमम् ॥३॥
verses.english: Saudasa said O holy one, O sinless one, what is that in the three worlds which is sacred and by reciting which at all times a man may win high merit?

verses.sanskrit: भीष्म उवाच। तस्मै प्रोवाच वचनं प्रणताय हितं तदा । गवामुपनिषद्विद्वान्नमस्कृत्य गवां शुचिः ॥४॥
verses.english: Bhishma said Having first bowed to kine and purified himself, the learned Vashishtha described to king Saudasa who stood before him with head bent in reverence, the mystery about kine, a subject that is fraught with results highly beneficial to all persons.

verses.sanskrit: गावः सुरभिगन्धिन्यस्तथा गुग्गुलुगन्धयः । गावः प्रतिष्ठा भूतानां गावः स्वस्त्ययनं महत् ॥५॥
verses.english: Vashishtha said Kine, are always fragrant. The perfume of the Amyris agallochum comes out of their bodies. Kine are the great refuge of all creatures. Kine form the greet source of blessings to all.

verses.sanskrit: गावो भूतं च भव्यं च गावः पुष्टिः सनातनी । गावो लक्ष्म्यास्तथा मूलं गोषु दत्तं न नश्यति ॥६॥
verses.english: Kine are the Past and the Future. Kine are the root of eternal growth. Kine are the root of Prosperity. Anything given to kine is never lost.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नं हि परमं गावो देवानां परमं हविः । स्वाहाकारवषट्कारौ गोषु नित्यं प्रतिष्ठितौ ॥७॥
verses.english: Kine from the highest food. They are the best Havi for the celestials. The Mantras called Svaha and Vashat are forever established in kine.

verses.sanskrit: गावो यज्ञस्य हि फलं गोषु यज्ञाः प्रतिष्ठिताः । गावो भविष्यं भूतं च गोषु यज्ञाः प्रतिष्ठिताः ॥८॥
verses.english: Kine form the fruit of sacrifices. Sacrifices are established in kine. Kine are the Future and the Past, and the Sacrifices rest on them.

verses.sanskrit: सायं प्रातश्च सततं होमकाले महाद्युते । गावो ददति वै हौम्यमृषिभ्यः पुरुषर्षभ ॥९॥
verses.english: Morning and evening kine give to the Rishis, O foremost of men, Havi for use in Homa, O you of great effulgence.

verses.sanskrit: यानि कानि च दुर्गाणि दुष्कृतानि कृतानि च । तरन्ति चैव पाप्मानं धेनुं ये ददति प्रभो ॥१०॥
verses.english: They who make gifts of kine succeed in getting over all sins which they may have committed and all kinds of dangers into which they may fall, O you of great power.

verses.sanskrit: एकां च दशगुर्दद्याद्दश दद्याच्च गोशती । शतं सहस्रगुर्दद्यात्सर्वे तुल्यफला हि ते ॥११॥
verses.english: The man possessing ten kine and making a gift of one cow, one possessing a hundred kine and making a gift of ten kine, and one possessing a thousand kine and making a gift of a hundred kine, all acquire the same measure of merit.

verses.sanskrit: अनाहिताग्निः शतगुरयज्वा च सहस्रगुः । समृद्धो यश्च कीनाशो नार्घमर्हन्ति ते त्रयः ॥१२॥
verses.english: That man who, having hundred kine, does not establish a domestic fire for daily worship that man who though possessed of a thousand kine does not celebrate sacrifices, and that man who though having riches acts as a miser, are all three considered as not worthy of any respect.

verses.sanskrit: कपिलां ये प्रयच्छन्ति सवत्सां कांस्यदोहनाम् । सुव्रतां वस्त्रसंवीतामुभौ लोकौ जयन्ति ते ॥१३॥
verses.english: Those men who make gifts of Kapila kine with their calves and with vessels of white brass for milking themkine, which are not vicious and which, while given away, are one wrapped round with clothsconquer both this and the next world.

verses.sanskrit: युवानमिन्द्रियोपेतं शतेन शतयूथपम् । गवेन्द्रं ब्राह्मणेन्द्राय भूरिशृङ्गमलङ्कृतम् ॥१४॥
verses.english: Such persons as make gifts of a young bull, that has all its senses, strong, and that may be considered as the foremost among hundreds of herds, that has large horns adorned with ornaments, to a Brahmana endued with Vedic lore, succeed, O scorcher of foes, in acquiring great prosperity riches each time they are born in the world.

verses.sanskrit: वृषभं ये प्रयच्छन्ति श्रोत्रियाय परन्तप । ऐश्वर्यं तेऽधिगच्छन्ति जायमानाः पुनः पुनः ॥१५॥
नाकीर्तयित्वा गाः सुप्यात्तासां संस्मृत्य चोत्पतेत् । सायंप्रातर्नमस्येच्च गास्ततः पुष्टिमाप्नुयात् ॥१६॥
verses.english: One should never go to bed without reciting the names of kine. Nor should one rise from bed in the morning without similarly reciting the names of kine, Morning and evening one should bend one's head respectfully to kine. As the result of such deeds, one is sure to acquire great prosperity.

verses.sanskrit: गवां मूत्रपुरीषस्य नोद्विजेत कथञ्चन । न चासां मांसमश्नीयाद्गवां पुष्टिं तथाप्नुयात् ॥१७॥
verses.english: One should never feel any repugnance for the urine and the dung of the cow. One should never eat the meat of kine. As the result of this, one is sure to acquire great prosperity.

verses.sanskrit: गाश्च संकीर्तयेन्नित्यं नावमन्येत तास्तथा । अनिष्टं स्वप्नमालक्ष्य गां नरः संप्रकीर्तयेत् ॥१८॥
verses.english: One should always recite the names of kine. One should never show any disregard for kine in any way. If evil dreams are seen men should recite the names of kine.

verses.sanskrit: गोमयेन सदा स्नायात्करीषे चापि संविशेत् । श्लेष्ममूत्रपुरीषाणि प्रतिघातं च वर्जयेत् ॥१९॥
verses.english: One should always bathe, using cowdung. One should sit on dried cowdung. One should never pass urine and excreta and other secretions on cowdung. One should never obstruct kine in any way.

verses.sanskrit: सार्द्रे चर्मणि भुञ्जीत निरीक्षेद्वारुणीं दिशम् । वाग्यतः सर्पिषा भूमौ गवां पुष्टिं सदाऽश्नुते ॥२०॥
verses.english: One should eat, sitting on a cowhide purified by dipping it in water, and then look towards the west. Sitting with controlled speech, one should eat clarified butter using the bare earth as his dish. One reaps, on account of such deeds, that prosperity of which kine are the root.

verses.sanskrit: घृतेन जुहुयादग्निं घृतेन स्वस्ति वाचयेत् । घृतं दद्या‌द्घृतं प्राशेद्गवां पुष्टिं सदाऽश्नुते ॥२१॥
verses.english: One should pour libations on the fire, using clarificd butter for purpose. One should make Brahmanas utter blessings upon one by presents of clarified butter. One should make gifts of clarified butter. One should also eat clarified butter. As the reward of such deeds one is sure to acquire that prosperity which kine grant.

verses.sanskrit: गोमत्या विद्यया धेनुं तिलानामभिमन्त्र्य यः । सर्वरत्नमयीं दद्यान्न स शोचेत्कृताकृते ॥२२॥
verses.english: That man who inspires a cow's form made of sesame seeds by uttering the Vedic Mantras named Gomati, and then adorns that form with every sort of gems and makes a gift of it, has never to suffer any grief on account of all his deeds of omission and commission.

verses.sanskrit: गावो मामुपतिष्ठन्तु हेमशृंग्यः पयोमुचः । सुरभ्यः सौरभेय्यश्च सरितः सागरं यथा ॥२३॥
verses.english: Let kine which give profuse milk and which have horns adorned with goldkine viz., that are Surabhis or the daughters of Surabhisapproach me even as rivers approach the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: गा वै पश्याम्यहं नित्यं गावः पश्यन्तु मां सदा । गावोऽस्माकं वयं तासां यतो गावस्ततो वयम् ॥२४॥
verses.english: I always look at kine. Let kine always look at me. Kine are ours. We are theirs. We are there where kine are.

verses.sanskrit: एवं रात्रौ दिवा चापि समेषु विषमेषु च । महाभयेषु च नरः कीर्तयन्मुच्यते भयात् ॥२५॥
verses.english: Thus, at night or day, in weal or woe-at times of even great fearshould a man exclaim. By uttering such words, he is sure to become freed from every fear. By uttering such words, he is sure to become freed from every fear.
